note: Instance-level overrides. No existing script in scripts/figma/ applies these; each row names the exact plugin-API call so a small applier is mechanical. Every row is unresolved-id because no instance id and no componentProperties map was ever read from the file — the quota ran out before that read.

rows.why: SH-A-01 (Critical) + UX-F-21 — the Topbar's Publish=ready variant, the everyday pressable CTA, is used by ZERO of the 15 numbered Shell boards; all 15 instance Publish=disabled, so the state a user is in for most of a session is drawn nowhere. 199:2 'Shell state 2 · Returning (default)' is the board that should carry it: it is the default returning shell.
rows.applier-must: Read the instance's componentProperties FIRST and use the real property name and value strings. SH-B-19's census says one of the six variants is used by nothing and three quarters of the file draws publishing blocked, so the value set is known to exist; its spelling is not.
rows.read-back: the instance's componentProperties after the write, plus the rendered CTA label

rows.why: UX-F-02 + SH-C-03 — board 5 'Drawer closed' draws a completely neutral rail, so the file agrees with the code's bug rather than with the design. Selected and open are two signals: with the drawer shut the last tool keeps its tinted pill (ls-btn--last, LeftSidebar.css:189) and loses only the 3px bar. The variant carries both, so the bar is hidden as an instance override.
rows.companion-board: Rail · selected vs open (two signals) — the anatomy this override makes real on a state board
rows.read-back: the instance's Active property and the visibility of its 'active bar' child
